title: Fatal Fury 2
shortDescription: Fatal Fury 2 helps define a Super Nintendo Entertainment System fighting path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced fighting option to the Super Nintendo Entertainment System discovery path.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Documented for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System fighting discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains a labeled reference path, not a popularity claim.
